title: The Inca
tagline: The Inca Empire and the Spanish conquest

hook.deadpan: 1438. Cusco is a small kingdom in the Andes. Its new ruler disagrees with 'small'.
hook.epic: From one valley to the largest empire in the Americas.

beats: Pachacuti takes power
Pachacuti fights off the Chanka and starts expanding. A lot.
Pachacuti: the Inca begin to build an empire.
Chimor conquered
The Chimú had a rich empire on the coast. Had.
The coastal empire of Chimor falls to the Inca.
Huayna Capac rules
Huayna Capac rules from Chile to Ecuador, linked by thousands of kilometres of road.
Huayna Capac: the empire at its greatest extent.
Huayna Capac dies
An epidemic arrives before the Spanish do. The emperor dies.
Smallpox kills Huayna Capac. Civil war follows.
Atahualpa wins the civil war
Two brothers fight for the throne. Atahualpa wins.
Atahualpa defeats his brother Huáscar.
Cajamarca
About 170 Spaniards capture the emperor in an afternoon.
Cajamarca: Pizarro seizes Atahualpa.
Atahualpa executed
Atahualpa pays a room full of gold for his freedom. They kill him anyway.
Atahualpa pays his ransom, and is executed.
Cusco taken
The Spanish take Cusco.
The Inca capital falls.
Siege of Cusco
Manco Inca nearly takes Cusco back.
1536: Manco Inca besieges Cusco for months.
Potosí
A mountain of silver is found at Potosí. Spain gets very rich.
Potosí: the silver that will fund an empire.
Túpac Amaru executed
Vilcabamba falls. The last Inca ruler is executed.
1572: Túpac Amaru, the last Sapa Inca, is executed.
end_card: Every year. Every border. Explore it yourself.
